query: MATCH (c:CR) OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->(s:Spec) WHERE NOT EXISTS { MATCH (c)-[:MODIFIES]->(primary:Spec) WHERE primary.specNumber=s.specNumber } RETURN c.tdocNumber AS crTdoc,count(DISTINCT s.specNumber) AS affectedSpecCount ORDER BY affectedSpecCount DESC,crTdoc ASC LIMIT 10
